newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-DERBY BID FOR BAGGIO, PAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DERBY BID FOR BAGGIO, PAPER SAYS.

text.p: English side Derby County have made a multi-million dollar bid for Roberto Baggio, Italy's Gazzetta dello Sport newspaper reported on Sunday.
Gazzetta said Derby were prepared to spend 27 billion lire ($16 million) to sign Baggio, once the world's most expensive player, from AC Milan.
Derby, who signed Italian international midfielder Stefano Eranio from Milan in May, made an offer for Baggio after talks between the two clubs last Thursday, the paper said.
Baggio said last month he would leave the five-times European champions before the start of next season.
Italian newspapers have linked him to several clubs, including Vicenza, Napoli, Sampdoria and Spain's Barcelona and Atletico Madrid.
